customers:
CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    first_name character varying(100),
    last_name character varying(100),
    email character varying(255),
    phone character varying(50),
    country character varying(100),
    state character varying(100),
    city character varying(100),
    customer_segment character varying(50),
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (customer_id)
);
drivers:
CREATE TABLE drivers (
    driver_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    driver_name character varying(100),
    phone character varying(50),
    license_number character varying(100),
    license_type character varying(50),
    experience_years integer,
    status character varying(30),
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (driver_id)
);
event_outbox:
CREATE TABLE event_outbox (
    id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('event_outbox_id_seq'::regclass),
    event_id uuid NOT NULL,
    event_type character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    aggregate_type character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    correlation_id character varying(100),
    payload jsonb NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    published_at timestamp with time zone,
    status character varying(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING'::character varying,
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
inventory:
CREATE TABLE inventory (
    inventory_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('inventory_inventory_id_seq'::regclass),
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    on_hand_quantity integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reserved_quantity integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    damaged_quantity integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    available_quantity integer,
    safety_stock integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reorder_point integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reorder_quantity integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    last_updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    location_id character varying(30),
    inventory_status character varying(30) DEFAULT 'RECEIVED'::character varying,
    PRIMARY KEY (inventory_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES warehouse_locations(location_id)
);
inventory_adjustments:
CREATE TABLE inventory_adjustments (
    adjustment_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    location_id character varying(30),
    previous_quantity integer NOT NULL,
    adjusted_quantity integer NOT NULL,
    adjustment_difference integer NOT NULL,
    adjustment_reason character varying(100),
    reference_task_id character varying(30),
    worker_id character varying(30),
    correlation_id uuid,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    task_id character varying(30),
    adjusted_by character varying(30),
    PRIMARY KEY (adjustment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES warehouse_locations(location_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES warehouse_tasks(task_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (adjusted_by) REFERENCES workers(worker_id)
);
inventory_allocations:
CREATE TABLE inventory_allocations (
    allocation_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    order_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    allocated_quantity integer NOT NULL,
    allocation_status character varying(30),
    allocated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    correlation_id uuid,
    PRIMARY KEY (allocation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id)
);
inventory_locations:
CREATE TABLE inventory_locations (
    inventory_location_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('inventory_locations_inventory_location_id_seq'::regclass),
    product_id character varying(30),
    warehouse_id character varying(20),
    location_id character varying(30),
    quantity integer,
    created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (inventory_location_id)
);
inventory_reservations:
CREATE TABLE inventory_reservations (
    reservation_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    order_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    quantity integer NOT NULL,
    reservation_status character varying(30),
    reserved_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    correlation_id uuid,
    PRIMARY KEY (reservation_id)
);
inventory_snapshots:
CREATE TABLE inventory_snapshots (
    snapshot_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('inventory_snapshots_snapshot_id_seq'::regclass),
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    on_hand_quantity integer NOT NULL,
    reserved_quantity integer DEFAULT 0,
    damaged_quantity integer DEFAULT 0,
    available_quantity integer NOT NULL,
    safety_stock integer,
    reorder_point integer,
    snapshot_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (snapshot_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id)
);
inventory_transactions:
CREATE TABLE inventory_transactions (
    transaction_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('inventory_transactions_transaction_id_seq'::regclass),
    product_id character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    transaction_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    quantity integer NOT NULL,
    reference_type character varying(50),
    reference_id character varying(100),
    task_id character varying(100),
    shipment_id character varying(100),
    correlation_id uuid,
    created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    inventory_id bigint NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (transaction_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (inventory_id) REFERENCES inventory(inventory_id)
);
order_items:
CREATE TABLE order_items (
    order_item_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('order_items_order_item_id_seq'::regclass),
    order_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    quantity integer NOT NULL,
    unit_price numeric NOT NULL,
    total_price numeric NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (order_item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id)
);
orders:
CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    customer_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    order_status character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    order_channel character varying(50),
    priority character varying(30),
    total_items integer DEFAULT 0,
    total_quantity integer DEFAULT 0,
    total_amount numeric,
    currency character(3) DEFAULT 'USD'::bpchar,
    order_date timestamp with time zone,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    confirmed_at timestamp with time zone,
    promised_delivery_date timestamp with time zone,
    correlation_id uuid,
    items_created boolean DEFAULT false,
    PRIMARY KEY (order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id)
);
package_items:
CREATE TABLE package_items (
    package_item_id bigint NOT NULL,
    package_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    quantity integer NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (package_id) REFERENCES packages(package_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id)
);
packages:
CREATE TABLE packages (
    package_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    order_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    package_type character varying(50),
    total_items integer DEFAULT 0,
    total_quantity integer DEFAULT 0,
    weight_kg numeric,
    length_cm numeric,
    width_cm numeric,
    height_cm numeric,
    package_status character varying(30),
    packed_by character varying(30),
    packed_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    correlation_id uuid,
    PRIMARY KEY (package_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (packed_by) REFERENCES workers(worker_id)
);
payments:
CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    order_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    customer_id character varying(30),
    payment_status character varying(30),
    payment_method character varying(50),
    payment_gateway character varying(50),
    transaction_id character varying(100),
    amount numeric,
    currency character(3),
    fraud_score numeric,
    payment_time timestamp with time zone,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (payment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id)
);
products:
CREATE TABLE products (
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    sku character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    barcode character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    name text NOT NULL,
    description text,
    category_level_1 character varying(100),
    category_level_2 character varying(100),
    category_level_3 character varying(100),
    brand character varying(150),
    attributes_color character varying(100),
    attributes_size character varying(100),
    attributes_material character varying(150),
    cost_price numeric,
    selling_price numeric,
    currency character(3) DEFAULT 'USD'::bpchar,
    supplier_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    storage_type character varying(50),
    shelf_life_days integer,
    weight_kg numeric,
    fragile boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    hazardous boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    status character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (product_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id)
);
purchase_order_items:
CREATE TABLE purchase_order_items (
    po_item_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('purchase_order_items_po_item_id_seq'::regclass),
    po_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    ordered_quantity integer NOT NULL,
    unit_cost numeric NOT NULL,
    total_cost numeric,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (po_item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (po_id) REFERENCES purchase_orders(po_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id)
);
purchase_orders:
CREATE TABLE purchase_orders (
    po_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    supplier_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    po_status character varying(30) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CREATED'::character varying,
    order_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    expected_delivery timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    total_items integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    total_quantity integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    total_amount numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    currency character(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD'::bpchar,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    correlation_id uuid,
    PRIMARY KEY (po_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id)
);
shipment_checkpoints:
CREATE TABLE shipment_checkpoints (
    checkpoint_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    shipment_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    tracking_id character varying(30),
    vehicle_id character varying(30),
    driver_id character varying(30),
    latitude numeric,
    longitude numeric,
    location_name character varying(100),
    distance_completed_km numeric,
    estimated_delay_minutes integer,
    traffic_status character varying(30),
    weather_condition character varying(50),
    checkpoint_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    correlation_id uuid,
    checkpoint_sequence integer,
    checkpoint_status character varying(30),
    PRIMARY KEY (checkpoint_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (shipment_id) REFERENCES shipments(shipment_id)
);
shipment_items:
CREATE TABLE shipment_items (
    shipment_item_id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('shipment_items_shipment_item_id_seq'::regclass),
    shipment_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    product_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    shipped_quantity integer NOT NULL,
    received_quantity integer DEFAULT 0,
    damaged_quantity integer DEFAULT 0,
    PRIMARY KEY (shipment_item_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (shipment_id) REFERENCES shipments(shipment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id)
);
shipment_loading_events:
CREATE TABLE shipment_loading_events (
    loading_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    shipment_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    vehicle_id character varying(30),
    trailer_id character varying(30),
    loaded_quantity integer,
    loading_status character varying(30),
    loaded_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    correlation_id uuid,
    PRIMARY KEY (loading_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (shipment_id) REFERENCES shipments(shipment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id)
);
shipment_tracking:
CREATE TABLE shipment_tracking (
    tracking_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    shipment_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    vehicle_id character varying(30),
    driver_id character varying(30),
    status character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    latitude numeric,
    longitude numeric,
    departure_time timestamp with time zone,
    estimated_arrival timestamp with time zone,
    actual_arrival timestamp with time zone,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    correlation_id uuid,
    PRIMARY KEY (tracking_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (shipment_id) REFERENCES shipments(shipment_id)
);
shipment_transportation:
CREATE TABLE shipment_transportation (
    id bigint NOT NULL,
    shipment_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    vehicle_id character varying(30),
    trailer_id character varying(30),
    driver_id character varying(30),
    assigned_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    status character varying(30),
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    FOREIGN KEY (shipment_id) REFERENCES shipments(shipment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES vehicles(vehicle_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (trailer_id) REFERENCES trailers(trailer_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (driver_id) REFERENCES drivers(driver_id)
);
shipments:
CREATE TABLE shipments (
    shipment_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    po_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    supplier_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    shipment_status character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    shipment_date timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    expected_delivery timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    actual_delivery timestamp with time zone,
    total_skus integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    total_quantity integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    correlation_id uuid NOT NULL,
    receiving_task_created boolean DEFAULT false,
    PRIMARY KEY (shipment_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(supplier_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id)
);
suppliers:
CREATE TABLE suppliers (
    supplier_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    supplier_name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    supplier_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    category_supported text NOT NULL,
    contact_email character varying(255),
    contact_phone character varying(50),
    country character varying(100),
    state character varying(100),
    city character varying(100),
    rating numeric,
    payment_terms character varying(20),
    lead_time_days integer,
    status character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (supplier_id)
);
trailers:
CREATE TABLE trailers (
    trailer_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    trailer_number character varying(50),
    trailer_type character varying(50),
    capacity_kg numeric,
    status character varying(30),
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (trailer_id)
);
vehicles:
CREATE TABLE vehicles (
    vehicle_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    vehicle_number character varying(50),
    vehicle_type character varying(50),
    capacity_kg numeric,
    fuel_type character varying(30),
    status character varying(30),
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (vehicle_id)
);
warehouse_locations:
CREATE TABLE warehouse_locations (
    location_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    zone character varying(50),
    aisle character varying(20),
    rack character varying(20),
    shelf character varying(20),
    bin character varying(20),
    storage_type character varying(50),
    capacity_units integer,
    current_utilization integer DEFAULT 0,
    temperature_controlled boolean DEFAULT false,
    hazmat_allowed boolean DEFAULT false,
    status character varying(20) DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::character varying,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (location_id)
);
warehouse_tasks:
CREATE TABLE warehouse_tasks (
    task_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    task_type character varying(50),
    warehouse_id character varying(20),
    shipment_id character varying(30),
    product_id character varying(30),
    location character varying(50),
    quantity integer,
    priority character varying(20),
    status character varying(30),
    assigned_worker_id character varying(30),
    estimated_minutes integer,
    actual_minutes integer,
    created_at timestamp without time zone,
    completed_at timestamp without time zone,
    task_started_at timestamp with time zone,
    task_completed_at timestamp with time zone,
    created_by character varying(30),
    assigned_at timestamp with time zone,
    started_by character varying(30),
    completed_by character varying(30),
    failure_reason text,
    equipment_id character varying(30),
    correlation_id uuid,
    dock_location character varying(30),
    expected_quantity integer,
    received_quantity integer,
    discrepancy_quantity integer DEFAULT 0,
    counted_quantity integer,
    adjustment_processed boolean DEFAULT false,
    order_id character varying(30),
    allocation_id character varying(30),
    PRIMARY KEY (task_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (location) REFERENCES warehouse_locations(location_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(product_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (assigned_worker_id) REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (allocation_id) REFERENCES inventory_allocations(allocation_id)
);
warehouses:
CREATE TABLE warehouses (
    warehouse_id character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_code character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    warehouse_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    status character varying(20) NOT NULL,
    country character varying(100),
    state character varying(100),
    state_code character(2),
    city character varying(100),
    postal_code character varying(20),
    latitude numeric,
    longitude numeric,
    timezone character varying(100),
    total_area_sqft integer,
    storage_capacity_units bigint,
    dock_doors integer,
    receiving_docks integer,
    shipping_docks integer,
    operating_hours character varying(50),
    working_shifts integer,
    supported_storage_types jsonb,
    temperature_controlled boolean,
    temperature_min_c numeric,
    temperature_max_c numeric,
    hazmat_certified boolean,
    fragile_goods_supported boolean,
    perishable_goods_supported boolean,
    fulfillment_types jsonb,
    receiving_enabled boolean,
    putaway_enabled boolean,
    cross_docking_enabled boolean,
    returns_processing_enabled boolean,
    cycle_count_enabled boolean,
    automation_level character varying(30),
    conveyor_system boolean,
    automated_storage boolean,
    robotics_enabled boolean,
    warehouse_management_system character varying(100),
    daily_throughput_units bigint,
    average_dock_to_stock_hours numeric,
    inventory_accuracy_percent numeric,
    on_time_processing_percent numeric,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (warehouse_id)
);
worker_attendance:
CREATE TABLE worker_attendance (
    attendance_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    worker_id character varying(30),
    warehouse_id character varying(20),
    shift_start timestamp with time zone,
    shift_end timestamp with time zone,
    attendance_status character varying(30),
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(),
    PRIMARY KEY (attendance_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (worker_id) REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (warehouse_id) REFERENCES warehouses(warehouse_id)
);
worker_productivity:
CREATE TABLE worker_productivity (
    id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('worker_productivity_id_seq'::regclass),
    worker_id character varying(30),
    task_type character varying(50),
    units_processed integer,
    working_minutes integer,
    accuracy_score numeric,
    productivity_score numeric,
    recorded_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
    task_id character varying(30),
    warehouse_id character varying(20),
    correlation_id uuid,
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
);
workers:
CREATE TABLE workers (
    worker_id character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    employee_code character varying(50),
    first_name character varying(100),
    last_name character varying(100),
    role character varying(50),
    skill_set jsonb,
    warehouse_id character varying(20),
    shift_type character varying(30),
    employment_status character varying(30),
    hire_date date,
    created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
    experience_years integer,
    productivity_rating integer,
    certifications jsonb,
    current_status character varying(30) DEFAULT 'AVAILABLE'::character varying,
    shift_start_time timestamp with time zone,
    shift_end_time timestamp with time zone,
    hourly_rate numeric,
    PRIMARY KEY (worker_id)
);
